description: Move the calendar playhead — the point in the primary calendar "as of" which to view the race on the map/chart. Pass an integer (number of contests counted, 0 = before the first contest) or null for the full calendar —…

asof.description: Contests counted (0..calendar length), or null = full calendar. Ignored when contest/contest_index is given.

contest.description: Jump the playhead TO this contest — state postal ("FL"), 2-digit FIPS ("12"), or full name ("Florida"). asof becomes that contest's 1-based calendar index, so the contest itself is counted.

contest_index.description: 1-based calendar ordinal to jump to (the order list_primary_calendar returns). asof becomes this value — the contest at this index is counted.

party.description: Which party's calendar resolves contest/contest_index (default: the sim's own primary party from its mode).

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: set_primary_asof
